en.bodyHtml:
Open Face Chinese Poker (OFC): Rules, Structure, and Scoring

Author: Roman Shaposhnikov

Date: 12.01.2026

Open Face Chinese Poker (OFC) is a dynamic strategic poker variant where players do not bet but compete to build three strongest poker combinations from 13 cards across three rows. The game blends math, intuition, and excitement — especially in Fantasy mode.

Goal: Build Three Strong Rows

Each player arranges 13 cards into three independent hands, obeying the rule that strength must go from strongest to weakest.

RowCardsStrength
Bottom5 cardsStrongest
Middle5 cardsWeaker than bottom
Top3 cardsWeaker than middle

⚠️ Foul: If order is broken (middle stronger than bottom), the player fouls and opponents take all points for the hand.

How a Hand Plays Out

  1. Start: 5 cards dealt; place them across rows (e.g. 1 on top, 2 on middle, 2 on bottom).
  2. Next rounds: 3 cards dealt; place 2 face up, discard 1.
  3. Repeat until all 13 cards are placed.

After all 13 cards are placed, hands are compared row by row: bottom vs bottom, middle vs middle, top vs top.

Scoring

Points are awarded for winning each row plus Royalties for premium hands (quads, straight flush).

  • Win a row: +1 point.
  • Lose a row: -1 point.
  • Scoop (win all three rows): +3 bonus points.

Fantasy Round

Qualify with QQ+ on top without fouling. In Fantasy you receive 14–17 cards and set all 13 before others. Re-enter with trips on top in Fantasy.

Hand Rankings

Bottom and middle use standard rankings. Top (3 cards): pair, trips, or high card only — straights and flushes from three cards do not count.

  1. Royal flush
  2. Straight flush
  3. Four of a kind
  4. Full house
  5. Flush
  6. Straight
  7. Three of a kind
  8. Two pair
  9. Pair
  10. High card

Why OFC Is Popular

  • Pure strategy: no street betting or bluffing.
  • Fantasy adrenaline: huge swings in one hand.
  • Constant tension: decisions until the 13th card.
  • Flexibility: you choose which cards to keep or discard.

uz.bodyHtml:
Open Face Chinese Poker (OFC): Qoidalar, tuzilma va hisob

Muallif: Roman Shaposhnikov

Sana: 12.01.2026

Open Face Chinese Poker (OFC) — stavkasiz dinamik strategik poker: 13 kartadan uch qatorli eng kuchli kombinatsiyalarni yig'ish. O'yin matematika, intuitiya va hayajonni birlashtiradi — ayniqsa Fantasy rejimida.

Maqsad: uch kuchli qator yigish

Har bir o'yinchi 13 kartani uch mustaqil qo'lga joylashtiradi, kuch eng kuchlidan eng zaifgacha ketishi shart.

QatorKartalarKuch
Pastki5 kartaEng kuchli
O'rta5 kartaPastkidan past
Yuqori3 kartaO'rtadan past

⚠️ Foul: tartib buzilsa (o'rta pastkidan kuchli bo'lsa), o'yinchi foul bo'ladi va raqiblar barcha ochkolarni oladi.

Hand qanday o'tadi

  1. Boshlanish: 5 karta — qatorlarga joylashtirish (masalan, 1 yuqoriga, 2 o'rtaga, 2 pastga).
  2. Keyingi raundlar: 3 karta; 2 tasini ochiq joylashtirish, 1 tasini discard.
  3. 13 karta joylashtirilguncha davom etadi.

13 karta joylashtirilgach, qatorlar solishtiriladi: pastki-pastki, o'rta-o'rta, yuqori-yuqori.

Ochko hisobi

  • Qator yutish: +1 ochko.
  • Qator yutqazish: -1 ochko.
  • Scoop (uch qatorni yutish): +3 bonus.

Fantasy raundi

Yuqori qatorda QQ+ yig'ib, foul qilmasdan Fantasy ga kirish. Fantasy da 14–17 karta olinadi va barcha 13 karta boshqalardan oldin joylashtiriladi.

Kombinatsiyalar reytingi

Pastki va o'rta standart reyting. Yuqori (3 karta): faqat juft, set yoki yuqori karta.

Nega OFC mashhur?

  • Toza strategiya: stavka va bluff yo'q.
  • Fantasy hayajoni: bir handda katta o'zgarishlar.
  • Doimiy taranglik: 13-kartagacha qarorlar.

Ұпай

Open Face Chinese Poker (OFC): Қоидаҳо, сохтор ва ҳисоб

Муаллиф: Роман Шапошников

Сана: 12.01.2026

Open Face Chinese Poker (OFC) — намуди стратегии динамикии покер бе ставка: аз 13 корт се комбинатсияи қавитарин дар се сатр. Бозӣ математика, интуитсия ва ҳаяҷонро муттаҳид мекунад — махсусан дар режими Fantasy.

Ҳадаф: се сатри қавӣ

СатрКортҳоҚувват

⚠️ Foul: агар тартиб вайрон шавад, бозигар foul мешавад ва рақибон ҳамаи холҳоро мегиранд.

Чӣ гуна даст мегузарад

  1. Оғоз: 5 корт — ҷойгиркунӣ дар сатрҳо.
  2. Раундҳои баъдӣ: 3 корт; 2-ро кушода, 1-ро discard.
  3. Такрор то ҷойгиршавии 13 корт.

Ҳисоб

  • Бурдани сатр: +1 хол.
  • Scoop: +3 бонус.

Раунди Fantasy

Дар боло QQ+ — дар Fantasy 14–17 корт.
